title: The category-list loader says it loads by an absolute path from the checkout, but never defines how that check
text: The category-list loader says it loads by an absolute path from the checkout, but never defines how that checkout root is resolved or tests it. The existing pass accepts a cwd and the webhook/CLI can run outside the repository root, so implementation would have to guess between cwd-relative and module-relative resolution, risking an AC19 degradation in deployed runs. Specify the authoritative resolution mechanism and a non-root-CWD test.
